name: Modal Management Module
description: Manages modal content (create and control modals/dialogs) on the site.
project_description:
Drupal 8 and up Module for managing site modals.

Maintained and supported by

 Interactive Knowledge .

 This module creates a custom entity (Modal) and allows for different bundles. All are fieldable and provide template suggestions for each bundle type.

 Requirements
 
 
 Block module 
 Address Module 
 
 APIs supported 
 
 GeoIP2 PHP Library (included in module) 
 ipdata (requires API key from ipdata.co ) 
 AbstractAPI Geolocation API (requires API key from abstractapi.com ) 
 
 Installation & Configuration
 
 Install via composer (required) . See Using Composer to install Drupal for more information.
